bigmem.courtesy: Public high-memory partition: only for jobs needing more memory than normal provides. Sherlock's own limits apply.

dev.courtesy: Interactive only (`sh_dev`, `salloc`): Sherlock rejects batch jobs here, so `shk submit` refuses it. Debugging and short tests, never production runs.

service.courtesy: Public service partition: lightweight recurring administrative tasks such as transfers or backups, never computation. Sherlock's own limits apply.

gpu.courtesy: Public GPU partition: few GPUs, long queue, never preempted. Follow Sherlock's own per-user GPU limits.

owners.courtesy: Slurm requeues preempted jobs; scripts must checkpoint and resume. No cap.

bioe.courtesy: Department GPU partition: respect fairshare and leave room for other department users.

stat.courtesy: Department GPU partition: respect fairshare and leave room for other department users.

btrippe.courtesy: Courtesy budget about 2 jobs x 2 h while others are active; more (e.g. 4 jobs x 6 h) only when the partition is idle, typically 00:00-07:00.

possu.courtesy: Stricter than btrippe. Submit only between 00:00 and 07:00 Pacific, a few short jobs; never submit outside that window, not even short jobs.
